title: Complete Material Data Atlas
boundary: Book material reference data remains technical-review evidence. Canonical catalogue values and regional evidence retain manufacturer, grade, source, test-condition, lifecycle, value-status and process context. Typical or manufacturer-measured values are not guaranteed specifications, universal settings or production setpoints. Current supplier TDS/SDS/processing guidance, machine/mould limits and site controls remain authoritative.

canonicalCatalog.boundary: Compiled only from staged exact-grade records whose provenance stage is validated/published and which pass semantic QA. Internal staging/schema files are not part of the public runtime artifact. Commercial grade names may legitimately coexist when variant/revision/production identity differs.

regionalEvidence.scope: Asia including Singapore, Australia and New Zealand primary-source material evidence wave 2

regionalProfileIndex.countingRule: one manufacturer + exact grade identity equals one unique complete profile; multiple evidence rows enrich but do not increase profile count
regionalProfileIndex.role: Reconciliation/enrichment view only; it does not define complete Book material coverage.

coverage.completeDefinition: All canonical public exact-grade records plus every row in the governed Asia/Australia/New Zealand evidence wave.
